gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Offside spreads its letters wide, with curves that never quite close. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau follows in a sans with open-ended curves, and over many lines it stays easy and unhurried.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan has a hefty lowercase with plenty of daylight inside its curves. And Offside, with its widely tracked, level lines, is the one to let stand large while the body stays modest in size.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, its curve endings never touching. Offside's rope-like strokes match it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Offside tracks wide and keeps every line the same width through each turn. And Noto Sans Soyombo, with its sizable x-height and unclosed curves, would carry a long page of text comfortably.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Offside traces each glyph with a single thickness, widely spaced. Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves rope-like daylight in its curves and keeps short ascender stems, so extended reading feels light and approachable.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Commanding, wide-set Offside never lets its curves close. Noto Sans Tagbanwa sits beneath it with open curves and lowercase filling most of the height, so heading and text move as one even, modern voice.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Wide, stubborn curves, left open. The pair's strongest quality is how Offside's unthinning shoulders meet Noto Sans Vithkuqi, a plain sans with open throats and barely any step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-gf-offside-gf-radio-canada-big: Curves that refuse to close define Offside, widely tracked and quiet in weight. Radio Canada Big then fills each line with a tall x-height and a monoline skeleton, so a long stretch of sans text stays contemporary and clear.
gen-gf-offside-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro keeps a plain sans weight steady from word to word, with broad terminal gaps. But Offside is the one with presence, its wide tracking and open curves doing the commanding while the body simply informs.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sintony: Stencil-cut letters with mild stroke variation mark Metamorphous. Sintony, a sans-serif with a chunky, tall midzone and smooth, unclogged curves, gives the pair its strongest quality: a decorative top that sits easily over a body that reads cleanly.
